notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.notes:
Ready to try out the new and improved features ?

Two biomes: Island 🏝️ and Mountain 🗻

4 maps per biome

Longer cooldown for bomb placement 

Love potion becomes visually a magnet (same effect)

Crossbow is no longer a pickaxe 😁

New obstacles: teleport, tornado, bouncy mushroom, destructible cloud, powdery snow ,.. and slippery ice surfaces designed to drive you crazy (and make you laugh just as much as we did) 🧊
